signature: SUBROUTINE DTGEXC( WANTQ, WANTZ, N, A, LDA, B, LDB, Q, LDQ, Z,

params.name: wantq
params.reference: .TRUE. : update the left transformation matrix Q; .FALSE.: do not update Q.

params.name: wantz
params.reference: .TRUE. : update the right transformation matrix Z; .FALSE.: do not update Z.

params.name: N
params.reference: The order of the matrices A and B. $N \ge 0$.

params.name: A
params.reference: On entry, the matrix A in generalized real Schur canonical form. On exit, the updated matrix A, again in generalized real Schur canonical form.

params.name: lda
params.reference: The leading dimension of the array A. $\mathrm{LDA} \ge \max (1,N)$.

params.name: B
params.reference: On entry, the matrix B in generalized real Schur canonical form (A,B). On exit, the updated matrix B, again in generalized real Schur canonical form (A,B).

params.name: ldb
params.reference: The leading dimension of the array B. $\mathrm{LDB} \ge \max (1,N)$.

params.name: Q
params.reference: On entry, if `WANTQ` = .TRUE., the orthogonal matrix Q. On exit, the updated matrix Q. If `WANTQ` = .FALSE., Q is not referenced.

params.name: ldq
params.reference: The leading dimension of the array Q. $\mathrm{LDQ} \ge 1$. If `WANTQ` = .TRUE., $\mathrm{LDQ} \ge N$.

params.name: Z
params.reference: On entry, if `WANTZ` = .TRUE., the orthogonal matrix Z. On exit, the updated matrix Z. If `WANTZ` = .FALSE., Z is not referenced.

params.name: ldz
params.reference: The leading dimension of the array Z. $\mathrm{LDZ} \ge 1$. If `WANTZ` = .TRUE., $\mathrm{LDZ} \ge N$.

params.name: ilst
params.reference: Specify the reordering of the diagonal blocks of (A, B). The block with row index `IFST` is moved to row `ILST`, by a sequence of swapping between adjacent blocks. On exit, if `IFST` pointed on entry to the second row of a 2-by-2 block, it is changed to point to the first row; `ILST` always points to the first row of the block in its final position (which may differ from its input value by +1 or -1). $1 \le \mathrm{IFST}$, $\mathrm{ILST} \le N$.

params.name: WORK
params.reference: On exit, if `INFO = 0`, `WORK(1)` returns the optimal `LWORK`.

params.name: lwork
params.reference:
The dimension of the array `WORK`. $\mathrm{LWORK} \ge 1$ when $N \le 1$, otherwise $\mathrm{LWORK} \ge 4 \, N + 16$.

If `LWORK = -1`, then a workspace query is assumed; the routine only calculates the optimal size of the `WORK` array, returns this value as the first entry of the `WORK` array, and no error message related to `LWORK` is issued by XERBLA.

params.name: info
params.reference:
-   `=0`: successful exit.
-   `<0`: if `INFO = -i`, the i-th argument had an illegal value.
-   `=1`: The transformed matrix pair (A, B) would be too far from generalized Schur form; the problem is ill- conditioned. (A, B) may have been partially reordered, and `ILST` points to the first row of the current position of the block being moved.

untranslated: WORK.minLength: local LWMIN is assigned inside nested control flow

overrides.reason: The JS API takes IFST and ILST 0-based (base.js and its tests index the diagonal with them directly), unlike dtrexc's 1-based IFST/ILST.
